subject: nursing
intro: Nursing leads to the bedside and beyond — registered and licensed practical nurses caring for patients, advanced practice nurses diagnosing and prescribing, all part of the licensed team hospitals run on.

roles.title: Registered Nurses
roles.what: Assess patient health problems and needs, develop and implement nursing care plans and maintain medical records, administering nursing care to ill, injured, convalescent or disabled patients and advising on health maintenance.
roles.where: The NCLEX-RN structure is the course: physiological adaptation, pharmacological therapies, safety and infection control and psychosocial integrity are the client-need categories you will practise every shift.

roles.title: Nurse Practitioners
roles.what: Diagnose and treat acute, episodic or chronic illness, independently or as part of a healthcare team — ordering and interpreting diagnostic tests, prescribing medication and focusing on health promotion and disease prevention.
roles.where: Physiological adaptation across cardiovascular, endocrine and renal disorders, reduction of risk potential and diagnostics, and the pharmacology unit give the assess-and-prescribe foundation graduate programmes build on.

roles.title: Nurse Anesthetists
roles.what: Administer anesthesia, monitor patients' vital signs and oversee recovery from anesthesia, assisting anesthesiologists, surgeons, other physicians or dentists across the perioperative period.
roles.where: Fluids, electrolytes and acid–base, physiological adaptation and emergency response, plus medication safety from the pharmacology strand are the physiology and drug knowledge anesthesia school deepens.

roles.title: Licensed Practical and Licensed Vocational Nurses
roles.what: Care for ill, injured or convalescing patients in hospitals, nursing homes, clinics and private homes — measuring vitals, giving basic care and medications, usually under a registered nurse's supervision.
roles.where: Basic care and comfort — nutrition and elimination, mobility and skin integrity — plus safety and infection control and medication safety map directly onto the practical, licensed scope of this entry role.
